name: Big Bend Ranch State Park - Madera Canyon
note: Primitive River District campground (Lower Madera Canyon) on FM 170 (River Road) in Big Bend Ranch SP - with Grassy Banks the only River District campground designated for trailer camping. 2 trailer sites at a gravel pull-through loop beside the highway; composting toilet and picnic tables, no hookups. Site lengths are not published - TPWD discourages big rigs in the park. Dark skies, no cell service. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: PUBLIC-pass miss surfaced by the private-gap list (RV Life tags it commercial). Hipcamp's listing (shared by AWH 2026-10-04; call to reserve, 2 sites RV/tent) describes it as one of the two 'trailer camping' campgrounds in Big Bend Ranch and easy on trailer axles; satellite 2026-10-04 shows a ~40 m gravel pull-through loop with a shelter beside FM 170, long enough for a 23-ft trailer plus tow vehicle; no published max length (Grassy Banks 7013 precedent); Google 'Lower Madera Canyon Campground' 4.8/27 with the park phone

lead.wf_evidence: satellite (Esri, 300 m frame) at 29.2936,-103.9177: the trailer loop sits beside FM 170 on a desert bench; the Rio Grande is out of frame to the SW beyond the canyon tent sites; not waterfront
